title: Investment authority register
objective: Record sponsor policy, investment committee delegation, manager mandate, account scope, limits, expiry and revocation for every investment authority; deny actions outside it.
owner: Unassigned (proposed: Echelon counsel for regulatory boundary; sponsor investment committee for authority)

title: No-recommendation boundary for AI and product features
objective: Restrict AI and product content about investment options to approved option metadata; block generation of fund- or donor-specific securities or allocation recommendations.
owner: Unassigned (proposed: Echelon counsel for regulatory boundary; sponsor investment committee for authority)
residual_risks: Prompt or content drift could produce advice-like output; requires adversarial testing not yet designed.

title: Allocation election validation
objective: Validate each election against current menu, minimums, restrictions and effective date; reject backdated or ineligible elections.

title: Drift and post-trade compliance monitor
objective: Compare holdings reported by the manager to target allocations and policy limits; open exceptions for drift beyond tolerance.

title: Controlled valuation publication state machine
objective: Publish a valuation only via a gated transition requiring validated inputs, tolerance check and either a recorded delegation or human approval.
owner: Unassigned (proposed: sponsor Fund Controller under investment committee delegation)

title: Fixed-precision decimal money and unit types
objective: Represent all authoritative monetary and unit values with fixed-precision decimal types and explicit rounding; prohibit binary floating point in these paths.
implementing_systems: Unbound (specified, not built); F# decimal type
owner: Unassigned (proposed: sponsor Fund Controller under investment committee delegation)

title: Valuation determinism property tests
objective: Property-test that valuations, unit issuance and redemption are reproducible from the same inputs and conserve totals within residual policy.
owner: Unassigned (proposed: sponsor Fund Controller under investment committee delegation)

title: Correction impact registry and bounded propagation
objective: Map each correctable fact to derived records; compute impacts and require approval before propagating corrections.

title: Policy limit monitor
objective: Evaluate reported holdings against versioned policy limits (prohibited assets, concentration, liquidity) and open exceptions.
owner: Unassigned (proposed: sponsor investment committee with compliance owner)

title: Liquidity buffer gate
objective: Prevent grant funding plans that would breach the approved liquidity buffer without approval.
owner: Unassigned (proposed: sponsor investment committee with compliance owner)

title: Excess business holdings computation
objective: Compute combined holdings with related persons at acceptance and on related transactions; track disposal deadlines.
owner: Unassigned (proposed: sponsor investment committee with compliance owner)

title: Performance methodology declaration
objective: Every performance report declares return method, benchmark, fee basis, cash-flow treatment and as-of date; reports lacking any element are rejected.
owner: Unassigned (proposed: sponsor investment committee; Unbound reporting owner)

title: Investment governance review schedule
objective: Schedule and track manager reviews, policy reviews and delegation renewals with overdue escalation.
owner: Unassigned (proposed: sponsor investment committee; Unbound reporting owner)

title: Pricing hierarchy and exception engine
objective: Select prices by approved hierarchy and freshness limits; raise exceptions for stale, conflicting, missing or outlier prices; prohibit silent forward-fill.
owner: Unassigned (proposed: sponsor Controller with valuation committee)

title: Illiquid valuation approval
objective: Require documented methodology, approver and age limit for each illiquid valuation; expire and re-trigger on age or event.
owner: Unassigned (proposed: sponsor Controller with valuation committee)
